description: This Java class models an entity for tracking downloadable products associated with an order in an e-commerce system. It includes fields for download limits, download count, and references to the product and order data.

classes.name: OrderProductDownload
classes.description: Entity class representing downloadable information for a product in an order, including IDs, filenames, download limits, and counts.

methods.name: OrderProductDownload
methods.description: Default constructor for the entity class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the download record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the download record.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Associates an OrderProduct with this download record.

methods.name: getOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the downloadable product.

methods.name: setOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename for the downloadable product.

methods.name: getMaxdays
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of days the download is available.

methods.name: setMaxdays
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of days the download is available.
